stemMd:
The biographer did not dismiss the witness's account outright. She treated it as ______, useful for generating questions but not reliable enough to establish the sequence of events without corroboration.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The account is accepted only tentatively, pending corroboration. Provisional captures that limited status, between complete dismissal and final proof.

distractorRationale.d: The account cannot establish events without additional support.
distractorRationale.b: It remains useful for generating questions.
distractorRationale.c: The text does not claim complete coverage of every event.
